# bl-halo-mcp - full index

Fleet MCP wrapper for Brilliant Labs Halo (Frame-compatible) AI glasses.
MOCK-first: every operation works without hardware or BLE.

## MCP tools (stdio via `uv run python -m bl_halo_mcp.run_server`, HTTP via `--serve` + `/mcp`)

- `halo_device` (portmanteau, 19 ops, readonly except connect/disconnect/show/run/deploy/noa/miniapp):
  status, list_devices, connect, disconnect, show_text (<=500 chars), show_image
  (base64 <=2MB), clear_display, capture_photo, list_photos (limit/offset/has_more),
  imu_read, tap_history, play_audio, record_audio (1-30s), run_lua (<=20k chars),
  list_lua_apps, deploy_lua (*.lua), noa_ask, miniapp_create, firmware_info.
  Returns `{success, message, result?, error?, error_type?, suggestions?, has_more?}`.
- `halo_dashboard` (Prefab app=True): device, battery, display, counts.
- `halo_help(topic?)`: pairing, lua, display, noa, ble.
- `halo_shutdown(confirm=True)`: guarded disconnect.
- Resource `skill://halo-dev/SKILL.md`; prompt `halo_recipe(goal)`.

## REST (Starlette, 11976, explicit CORS localhost+tauri only)

GET /api/health | /api/dashboard | /api/tools | /api/skills | /api/skills/{name} |
/api/devices | /api/photos?limit&offset | /api/logs | /api/llm/providers |
/api/llm/discover | /api/llm/models | /api/llm/gpus (nvidia-smi) |
POST /api/halo {operation, text?, image_b64?, lua_name?, duration_s?, limit?, offset?} |
POST /api/shutdown {confirm:true} | POST /api/llm/chat {message, skill?} (backend proxy only)

## Env (see .env.example)

BL_HALO_MOCK (default true), BL_HALO_DEVICE_MAC, BL_HALO_DEVICE_NAME,
BL_HALO_BACKEND_PORT=11976, BL_HALO_FRONTEND_PORT=11977, BL_HALO_DATA_DIR=data.

## Webapp (web_sota, Vite React + Zustand, 11977)

Routes: Dashboard (hero+KPIs+onboarding-cue+MOCK badges), Device (connect/photo/text),
Gallery (/api/photos), Lua (run/deploy/list), Inbox (/api/logs), Tools (live run),
Skills (SKILL.md reader), Chat (capped 100 history, skill-first pill, backend proxy),
Settings (Ollama/LMStudio probe + model persist + GPU select), Help, Logs.

## Hardware facts (Halo vs Frame)

Halo: ~40g wayfarer, 0.2in 640x480 RGB microOLED peripheral HUD, inference camera,
dual mics + audio-activity, 2x bone-conduction speakers, IMU, tap+click, NPU SoC,
~14h battery, $299-399. Frame: 640x400 OLED 20deg FOV, 720p camera, ~40g, $349.
Dev: host app + on-device Lua 5.4 frame.* over BLE (Halo Lua / Battery / OTA /
LE Audio services); brilliant-sdk (ble+msg) on PyPI; halo-emulator for HW-free dev;
Noa app (noa-flutter) + Narrative memory + Miniapps.

## Limits (declared doubles)

MOCK photos are 1x1 PNG fixtures; Noa answers carry [MOCK Noa] until paired;
IMU returns rest pose; no wrappee webhook API exists so no inbound webhooks.
